categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.rationale: Large board title and clear primary text work; the empty-state tip competes with entry, and scrolled boards lose the compact title.

categories.name: Spacing/grid
categories.rationale: Outer margins are consistent. Multiline rows have only thin inter-row breathing room and centered controls; Account spends too much of its medium detent on chrome.

categories.name: Typography scale
categories.rationale: Native title/body/caption styles produce a clear scale. Paragraph rows are readable; fixed 15pt Live Activity type is a source-only limitation.

categories.name: Dynamic Type
categories.rationale: XXXL screenshots visibly scale and the text-height gate passed. Capacity placeholder truncates at XXXL; account/sign-in and accessibility categories beyond XXXL were not captured.

categories.name: Light contrast
categories.rationale: Primary ink is strong, but the last line fades at rest and the empty composer placeholder is unusually faint. No numeric contrast measurement was supplied.

categories.name: Dark contrast
categories.rationale: Primary white-on-black text is clear. Final-row ink falls into black, empty composer cues are subdued, and Account background content leaks through the sheet.

categories.name: Iconography
categories.rationale: Existing native symbols are coherent and restrained. Completion circles and grip placement weaken multiline scanning; no symbol/name replacement is required.

categories.name: Safe area / Dynamic Island
categories.rationale: Captured app controls sit below status content; the test reaches the Account size failure after its safe-area assertion. Actual compact/expanded ActivityKit geometry remains unobserved.

categories.name: Scroll/pull-down / last row
categories.rationale: All four bottom captures retain faded final-line ink despite geometry containment. Full-board pull test timed out before visibility assertion; recovered captures prove a bottom state, not robust pull behavior.

categories.name: List rows
categories.rationale: Unboxed rows and hairline separators suit the product. Completion circles centered halfway down long paragraphs and always-present grips impair start-of-row scanning.

categories.name: Empty states
categories.rationale: Clear empty status and a persistent entry affordance are useful. The three-step setup block dominates the first empty screen and is partially faded when composing.

categories.name: Composer ergonomics
categories.rationale: Bottom placement and separate send control are sound. The field reports only 22pt height; dismiss control is 32pt wide in source; XXXL capacity wording truncates.

categories.name: Keyboard handling
categories.rationale: Both captures show a correctly raised composer and native keyboard. Interactive dismissal is implemented; its UI test aborts before dismissal, so the full interaction is unverified.

categories.name: Sheet presentation/detents
categories.rationale: Native detents and drag indicator are present. Account opens at medium with a cramped viewport and distracting board text visible through its material; the paired Apple Details sheet is calmer.

categories.name: Navigation clarity
categories.rationale: Account and Done are recognizable. At bottom the large board title disappears without a visible compact replacement, leaving a tall blank navigation band.

categories.name: Touch targets
categories.rationale: Measured 22pt composer field and 36pt Account fail the 44pt gate. Source also gives keyboard dismissal only 32pt width. Several other controls explicitly allocate 44pt.

categories.name: Haptics
categories.rationale: Source provides success/error feedback and selection feedback at drag start. Timing and physical quality were not observed; this is provisional source-based credit.

categories.name: Animation/transitions
categories.rationale: Reduce Motion-aware board mutations and native movement exist. Collection updates use reloadData, and the pull run times out waiting for idle; smoothness is unproven.

categories.name: Loading states
categories.rationale: Source has initial loading, retry progress, provider progress, and submitting state with labels. None of these busy states was captured or exercised by this reviewer.

categories.name: Error states
categories.rationale: Source distinguishes empty-board failure, retained-content banner, and sign-in/account errors, with retry or dismissal. Runtime layout and announcement behavior are not captured.

categories.name: VoiceOver/labels
categories.rationale: Rows have text, state, and completion hints; reorder has named actions and position; successful changes post announcements. Traversal, focus retention and spoken output remain untested.

categories.name: iOS HIG consistency
categories.rationale: Native navigation, SF text, system colors, grouped settings and sheets establish a familiar base. Undersized targets, opaque-to-translucent inconsistencies and missing compact title reduce polish.

categories.name: Lock Screen / Live Activity
categories.rationale: Source implements a restrained banner and empty compact regions, but no actual native surface was captured. Fixed 15pt banner type and one-line truncation require device validation; this is a provisional source score.

categories.name: Sign-in/onboarding
categories.rationale: Provider and email routes are clear and copy is intact. Large outer cards containing inset filled controls add unnecessary layers; setup guidance visually outweighs first entry.

categories.name: Settings/account
categories.rationale: Grouped rows and neutral icons are appropriate. The initial medium sheet shows little content and its glass allows busy board text behind labels; lower settings are not captured.

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.rationale: Source uses a finite collection and avoids reload during drag. A pull-related idle timeout prevents a confident responsiveness claim; stills and unit passes do not establish frame timing.

categories.name: Delight
categories.rationale: Quiet monochrome board and native type are promising. Faded final words, missing compact title and crowded sheet interrupt the sense of effortless finish.

categories.name: Long text
categories.rationale: Default and XXXL rows wrap without ellipsis and the intrinsic-height check passed. Bottom ink still fades and centered controls make large paragraphs awkward; the capacity placeholder itself truncates.

categories.name: Reduced Motion / Transparency
categories.rationale: Board mutation animation and error material respect accessibility settings in source. The unconditional 36pt fade remains, and Account has no explicit solid-surface treatment; no settings-on captures exist.

categories.name: Palette / minimalism
categories.rationale: Main board is restrained and avoids decorative red/orange. Sign-in layers cards, filled fields and pills; Account adds busy transparency. Existing state/destructive colors are not decorative defects.

findings.evidence: Observed: final 'tomorrow.' / 'for tomorrow.' is visibly attenuated at the settled bottom. Exact dark pair reminders-bottom-dark.png leaves Final demo reminder fully readable. Source: ReminderListView.swift:290-296 overlays a 36pt gradient above the composer; BoardScrollEdge at line 521 also requests a soft bottom edge. Passed row-frame containment cannot measure obscured ink.
findings.fix: Give the final row enough scroll clearance above the entire fade footprint, or remove/disable that fade at the bottom. Use one deliberate edge treatment; keep existing reminder and capacity wording unchanged.
findings.check: Extend bottom regression to assert last text ink rect ends above fade start, not merely composer.minY. Capture settled final-row crops in both appearances at default and XXXL after pull, and measure/compare glyph contrast with an unfaded row. Rerun full-board pull and existing iOS suite.

findings.evidence: checks.json and bounded-ui-baseline-summary.json: New reminder height 22pt; Account width 36pt. ReminderListView.swift:241 explicitly sets keyboard-dismiss frame width 32, height 44; dismissal assertion was not reached.
findings.fix: Make the actual field and Account button hit/accessibility frames at least 44x44pt without enlarging their icons; make the keyboard dismiss target at least 44pt wide. Ensure padding is interactive rather than only decorative.
findings.basis: test-observed for field/Account; source-derived for dismissal
findings.check: Run testComposerKeyboardDismissTarget and testTopControlsAvoidIslandAndHave44PointTargets through completion; add taps near each target's padded corners to prove focus/action behavior, plus existing iOS suite.

findings.evidence: Observed board paragraphs show through the sheet's header and row backgrounds. Medium detent exposes only initial settings and cuts the persistence section near Refresh Board Now. Exact dark Apple Details reference is a quieter near-full-height surface. Source: ReminderListView.swift:96 starts medium/large detents.
findings.fix: Use an opaque semantic grouped presentation background and open this long settings sheet at .large; keep all current sections, wording, icons and Done. A medium option can remain if useful, but should not be the cramped initial presentation.
findings.check: Capture initial Account over a full board in light/dark and with Reduce Transparency; assert header and visible rows do not overlap and initial usable content height is appropriate. Exercise scrolling to bottom and Done at default/XXXL; run existing iOS suite.

findings.screen: full and long-text top/bottom, both appearances and sizes
findings.evidence: Completion circles and reorder grips sit at the vertical midpoint of six-to-twelve-line paragraphs. Paired reminders-top-light.png and reminders-bottom-dark.png anchor circles at the first line, making row starts clearer. ReminderRow uses default Label alignment; ReorderableReminderList.swift:101 uses a centered HStack.
findings.fix: Align the existing completion circle and grip to the first text line/top of multiline rows while preserving 44pt targets and the full text. Add modest vertical row padding without adding cards or shrinking text.
findings.check: Render short, two-line and long rows at default/XXXL in both appearances; assert control visual centers track first-line position and hit targets remain at least 44pt. Recheck bottom clearance and run existing iOS suite.

findings.evidence: At bottom Your Board and count disappear; a tall blank navigation band remains with Account at right and an abrupt content clip below. Exact dark Reminders bottom shows a compact title. UIKit collection bridge is the probable cause, not proven by stills.
findings.fix: Restore a native compact Your Board title during scrolling and ensure the collection view participates in navigation scroll-edge behavior. Keep the existing title and icon; do not add a replacement label over the status bar.
findings.confidence: high for visible issue; medium for cause
findings.check: Assert title visibility in both top and scrolled states, verify top content is clipped behind the proper navigation boundary, and capture pull-collapse-expand transitions. Run safe-area gate and existing iOS suite.

findings.evidence: Provider controls sit inside a rounded card; email field, submit button and a separate pill sit inside a second large rounded card. Apple dark Details reference uses grouped rows for a different task, not an authentication layout; it supports only a surface/typography comparison.
findings.fix: Flatten sign-in into one clear vertical form: remove redundant outer card fills while retaining all text, provider branding, icons, control order and accessible target sizes. Use spacing to group providers/email and keep the secondary password route visually quieter.
findings.check: Capture both appearances, email/password mode, keyboard and XXXL; verify no horizontal clipping and focus order is unchanged. Run existing iOS suite; no copy assertions need changing.

findings.evidence: Disabled capacity placeholder renders 'Board full — combine lines i…'. This is visible despite long-row text-height gate passing, because that gate covers reminder text rather than composer wording.
findings.fix: Render the existing capacity sentence in a wrapping, readable non-editable treatment when full, or otherwise allow that exact placeholder to wrap without ellipsis. Retain the complete wording and separate disabled send affordance.
findings.check: At XXXL and an accessibility text size, assert full capacity text is displayed without truncation and recompute final-row clearance after its height changes; run existing iOS suite.

findings.evidence: The empty-board setup instructions occupy a large central block and the first instruction is faded away behind the focused composer. The Apple empty reference is deliberately sparse; semantics differ because Notepad also explains cross-surface setup.
findings.fix: Reduce setup block prominence through spacing and typographic hierarchy, and keep the full instructions reachable in the scroll area when the keyboard appears. Preserve every existing sentence and symbol; avoid introducing another nested card.
findings.check: Focus the empty composer, scroll all setup instructions fully above the composer in both appearances/default/XXXL, dismiss the tip, and verify entry remains reachable. Run existing iOS suite.

findings.screen: board with Reduce Transparency / increased contrast (not captured)
findings.evidence: ReminderListView reads reduceTransparency/increased contrast for field border and error material, but its 36pt LinearGradient is unconditional. The final-row fading defect is observed with default settings; the accessibility-settings variant is a source-derived risk.
findings.fix: Disable the nonessential fading overlay when Reduce Transparency or increased contrast is active, while keeping bottom padding sufficient for full ink visibility. Ensure Account's solid surface follows the same semantic-color policy.
findings.confidence: high for source condition; medium for unseen settings result
findings.basis: source-derived risk, not observed accessibility behavior
findings.check: Add settings-on capture cases in both appearances, assert last-line legibility and no transparent content bleed, and run existing iOS suite.

evidence_gaps: Apple Notes was unavailable/not installed; no Notes comparison is claimed.
Four Reminders PNGs marked transition_rejected were excluded entirely: bottom-light, compose-dark, sheet-light, top-dark. Settled dark empty reference also absent.
Paired light long-text/XXXL references are default-size Reminders rows with different seeded content; no reference establishes exact density or same-size Dynamic Type parity.
Sign-in is a full-screen authentication form; its supplied dark pair is an item Details sheet. Account settings and item Details also differ semantically.
Native Lock Screen banner, compact/expanded Dynamic Island, device lock transitions and ActivityKit rendering were not captured. Source is not visual proof.
Haptics, VoiceOver traversal/focus/announcements, animation continuity, keyboard dismissal and performance feel were not observed interactively by this reviewer.
Loading, submitting, error, successful sign-in, account lower content/large detent, Reduced Motion, Reduce Transparency, increased contrast and accessibility text sizes beyond XXXL lack captures.

Full-board UI pull test timed out waiting for idle before its final assertion. Raw screenshot recovery used the prescribed inside-list drag; failed attempt remains in manifest. This neither proves app unresponsiveness nor proves smooth pull behavior.

Existing 247 XCTest cases passed, but overall recorded baseline run is Failed because new UI tests failed/cancelled. XXXL geometry pass establishes allocated-height/containment, not unattenuated text ink.

Capture manifest is dirty=true at source SHA de6cb90349ccc77af90c0fbf4870af3e39977ec5. PM reports merged app sources identical; later differences are tests/scripts/docs. This reviewer did not run a fresh build or runtime suite.
